item.title: Cost of Living in Gardenvale Melbourne
item.description:
Money matters when you’re choosing where to live. Here’s the real story on costs in Gardenvale — no sugar-coating, no made-up figures.

Read our full Gardenvale suburb guide for the bigger picture.

Is Gardenvale Expensive?

Gardenvale sits somewhere in the middle of Melbourne’s cost spectrum. It’s not cheap, but it’s not going to break the bank either — assuming you’re realistic about expectations.

The cost of living here reflects what the suburb offers. Location, community, access to amenities — you get what you pay for, and in Gardenvale, you’re generally getting good value for the price point.

item.title: Gardenvale — History and How It's Changed
item.description:
Every Melbourne suburb has a story. Gardenvale’s story is one of farmland and orchards that became suburban housing in the post-war boom. Understanding that history explains why the suburb feels the way it does today.

What Gardenvale Was Originally

Before it was what you see today, Gardenvale was agricultural land and market gardens. The original residents built the suburb’s foundation — the street grid, the housing stock, the community institutions that still exist in some form.
